response_body.content:
# GPU Training Strategy Options

## Option 1: Large Batch (512) + Gradient Accumulation
Pros:
- Better GPU utilization
- Faster wall-clock time per epoch
- More stable gradients

Cons:
- Higher memory pressure
- May need learning rate scaling
- Generalization gap concerns?

## Option 2: Small Batch (128) + Frequent Updates
Pros:
- Lower memory footprint
- More gradient updates per epoch
- Easier to tune

Cons:
- Slower training
- Noisier gradients
- May need more epochs

## Questions for Dr. Wang:
- Which approach aligns better with production deployment?
- Are there memory constraints I should know about?
- What did previous interns use for similar models?

response_body.title: GPU Training Strategy Decision - Pros and Cons Analysis
response_body.content:
# GPU Training Strategy Options

## Option 1: Large Batch (512) + Gradient Accumulation
Pros:
- Better GPU utilization
- Faster wall-clock time per epoch
- More stable gradients

Cons:
- Higher memory pressure
- May need learning rate scaling
- Generalization gap concerns?

## Option 2: Small Batch (128) + Frequent Updates
Pros:
- Lower memory footprint
- More gradient updates per epoch
- Easier to tune

Cons:
- Slower training
- Noisier gradients
- May need more epochs

## Questions for Dr. Wang:
- Which approach aligns better with production deployment?
- Are there memory constraints I should know about?
- What did previous interns use for similar models?

[Note: Started drafting email to Dr. Wang but not sure if these questions are too basic. Maybe I should run more experiments first?]
